The Yahusha (Jesus) named in Matt 1:21 IS the Son of Adam named at 1 Enoch 48:2.

The Father seats the Elect One on the throne of glory to judge. *They shall call his name Immanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us* (Matthew 1:23) — the enthroned one is the one who came in flesh.

The name revealed to the holy ones in heaven, to their joy, is the name given on earth to the child. The name is the gospel.

The Magi at Matt 2:1-2 recognized the star because the tradition that read prophetic signs in the heavens was alive in their territories.

quote: And I saw that a white bull was born, with large horns, and all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the air feared him and made petition to him all the time.

note: *And I saw that a white bull was born, with large horns, and all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the air feared him and made petition to him all the time.* (1 Enoch 90:37). The Animal Apocalypse ends where the Magi's watch ends: a white bull born at the close of the vision, large-horned, feared and petitioned by every beast and bird — the seed of Adam restored in one figure. *Where is he that is born King of the Yahudim (Jews)? for we have seen his star in the east* (Matthew 2:2). The men who read the heavens were looking for the one this vision had already shown.

quote: And I saw till all their generations were transformed, and they all became white bulls; and the first among them became a lamb, and that lamb became a great animal and had great black horns on its head; and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced over it and over all the oxen.

The lamb that becomes the great horned one — the Lamb who is also the King. The star of Matthew 2:2 announced a child; the vision had already shown what the child would be: the lamb grown into the one the Lord of the sheep rejoices over.

The *netser* (branch) of Isaiah 11:1 and the *plant of righteousness* of 1 Enoch 10:16 name the same figure.

quote: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.

note: *And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.* (1 Enoch 14:18). This is the room the open heaven of Matthew 3:16 gives onto — the lofty throne, the cherubim, the fire streaming from beneath it (1 Enoch 14:18–22). The heavens do not open onto emptiness; they open onto the throne of the Great Glory, and from that throne the voice of the next verse speaks.

They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.* (1 Enoch 71:1). The ascent that ends in the Head of Days naming the Son of Adam (1 Enoch 71:14) begins here, with the heavens opened to Enoch. At the Yarden (Jordan) the same heavens open and the same Father speaks over the same Son.

quote: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.

The Hebrew library's witness to the Spirit-on-the-Elect-One predates the gospel and frames what Matt 3:16 makes public.

quote: And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

Enoch heard two voices in the throne room: the first blessing Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits (1 Enoch 40:4), the second blessing the Elect One. The Father's voice at the river and the heaven's blessing of the Elect One speak of the same Son.

note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased* (Matthew 3:17). Enoch had already heard the Father name him: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness.* The voice at the river is the voice from the throne; the Son it names is the one righteousness never leaves.

quote: And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.

note: *And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.* 1 Enoch 6:1 opens the Watcher-rebellion narrative — the fallen angels' descent and the breeding of the Nephilim. Yochanan's (John's) *generation of vipers* (Greek *gennēmata echidnōn*, offspring of vipers) at Matt 3:7 names the Pharisaic-Sadducean leadership in the seed-war register the Hebrew library opens at 1 Enoch 6. The tares woven in by the fallen Watchers are the source of the seed Yochanan (John) identifies in his own day.

The seed-war pattern Yochanan (John) identifies at Matt 3:7 — and Yahusha (Jesus) re-identifies at Matt 23:33 and John 8:44 — has this 1 Enoch 6 origin in the Hebrew library's witness.

Yochanan (John) identifying the Pharisaic-Sadducean leadership as *offspring of vipers* is the gospel-front-end naming of the same persistent seed-line.

Matt 4:1's *the devil* who tempts Yahusha (Jesus) in the wilderness is named in the Hebrew library's witness: the same Watcher-chief whose rebellion seeded the corruption.

The Hebrew library places the bound Watcher in the same wilderness Matt 4:1 names as the location of Yahusha's (Jesus's) temptation. The Ruach (Spirit) leads Yahusha out to the very ground where the bound Watcher is held.

Matt 4:1's wilderness-confrontation reads against this architecture: Yahusha (Jesus) steps into the territory of the bound Watcher and walks the testing-arc on the figure's own ground.

Matt 4:1 places Yahusha (Jesus) himself in the wilderness in the same register: the Son-of-Adam-in-flesh walks out where the bound Watcher's sin is carried, and confronts the figure who is to bear it.

The fishers-of-men commission at Matt 4:19 enters the same awakening-architecture: the gathering of the scattered-and-now-awakening sheep, the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) opening their eyes when the Shepherd's voice reaches them.

The blessing is not an entry fee; it is the Father's own word over those who are already his. Enoch heard the same word before the Beatitudes were spoken: peace, protection, mercy, belonging — pronounced over the elect, not offered to applicants.

The Hebrew library lays down the comfort-of-the-righteous architecture the Beatitude inherits.

note: *Blessed are ye, ye righteous and elect, For glorious shall be your lot.* 1 Enoch 58:2 carries the direct *blessed-are-the-righteous-and-elect* register — beatitude-form pronounced over the gathered. Matt 5:10's *blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven* is the gospel-form of the same Hebrew library declaration: the righteous and elect are pronounced blessed, and the kingdom is theirs.

quote: And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.

The light the disciples carry is the light they were placed in.

note: *From that time those that possess the earth shall no longer be powerful and exalted: And they shall not be able to behold the face of the holy, For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has caused His light to appear On the face of the holy, righteous, and elect.* (1 Enoch 38:4). *A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid* (Matthew 5:14). Enoch saw the day the light appears on the face of the holy, righteous and elect, and the powerful can no longer behold it. The disciples on the mountain are the first sight of that city; the light that makes it visible is the Lord of Spirits' own.

quote: And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.

It had been good for them if they had not been born.* (1 Enoch 38:2). *Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 5:16). Enoch saw the day the light appears on the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth — and the question that day asks of the sinners. The shining is the Father's doing; the glory goes to him.

quote: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.
live_here: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.
live_proposed: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.
note: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.* 1 Enoch 99:2 names the woe-pattern against those who pervert the words of uprightness and transgress the eternal law. Matt 5:19's *whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven* walks the same diagnostic at the kingdom-status level. The Hebrew library carries the woe-form; the gospel carries the kingdom-status-naming. Both name the same act — perverting the words, transgressing the eternal law — and both refuse to soften the diagnostic.

quote: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.
live_here: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.
live_proposed: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.
note: *Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.* (1 Enoch 104:9). Enoch's charge to his children is the charge Matthew 5:19 makes to every teacher: do not alter the words of uprightness. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven.* To alter the words and to teach men so are one act; both are named here before the gospel names them.

quote: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.
live_here: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.
live_proposed: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.
note: *And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.* (1 Enoch 104:10). Enoch knew the mystery before the pulpit practised it: sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness, and write books about it. *Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so* (Matthew 5:19) — the teaching is the perverting; the books are the sermons. The kingdom-status of such teachers was fixed long before the sermon was preached.

quote: And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!

live_proposed: And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!
note: *And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!* (1 Enoch 9:4). Enoch's angels pray what the disciples are taught to pray: the holy and blessed name, the throne of glory that stands to all generations, the King of kings. *Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come* (Matthew 6:9–10) is the same prayer in the mouth of the children.

And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever, And throughout all generations Thy dominion; And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever, And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.

note: *‘Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (Lord), King, Great and mighty in Thy greatness, Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the heaven, King of kings and Elohim (God) of the whole world. And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever, And throughout all generations Thy dominion; And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever, And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 84:2). *Hallowed be thy name* (Matthew 6:9). Enoch's own prayer blesses the King whose dominion is through all generations and whose throne is the heavens. The disciples are taught to pray what the patriarch prayed.

quote: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.
live_here: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.
live_proposed: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.
note: *Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.* (1 Enoch 9:5). The One whose kingdom the disciples pray to come is the One who made all things and holds power over all things, from whom nothing hides. *Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven* (Matthew 6:10) asks nothing new; it asks that what is already true in heaven be seen on earth.

quote: And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.
live_here: And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.
live_proposed: And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.
note: *And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.* (1 Enoch 94:1). Two ways, and only two. Enoch sets them before his sons — the paths of righteousness worthy of acceptance, the paths of unrighteousness that vanish — long before Matthew 7:13's *wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction.* The choice at Deuteronomy 30:19 was already old when Enoch taught it.

quote: And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.
live_here: And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.
live_proposed: And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.
note: *And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.* (1 Enoch 94:2). Enoch sees it from the other side: the paths of violence and death are shown to certain men of a generation, and they keep far from them. *Strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it* (Matthew 7:14). The few who hold themselves afar are the few who find.

quote: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.
live_here: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.

note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *Many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Avraham (Abraham), and Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqov (Jacob), in the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 8:11). Enoch saw the sitting-down: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned. The many from east and west are the dispersed of the house coming home — the scattered sheep, not a new flock.

quote: And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.
live_here: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.
live_proposed: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.
note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* 1 Enoch 46:1 names the throne-room vision in the Hebrew library's apocalyptic register — the Head of Days and another being with the appearance of a man beside Him. This is the opening of the named-title Messianic-figure passage (1 Enoch 46:1-3) the framework reads as the load-bearing Hebrew-library parallel for Matt 8:20's *the Son of Adam.* The figure is named as the Christ in heavenly vision before the incarnation.

quote: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?
live_here: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?
live_proposed: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?
note: *And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?* (1 Enoch 46:2). Enoch asks who *that Son of Adam* is — a figure named by title, standing beside the Head of Days. When Yahusha (Jesus) says *the Son of Adam hath not where to lay his head* (Matthew 8:20) he takes that title for himself: the named one of the Parables, now with no bed on the earth he came to.

quote: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
live_here: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
live_proposed: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
note: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* 1 Enoch 46:3 locks the identification of the figure: *the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* This is the Christ — chosen, pre-eminent, the revealer of hidden treasures. The Hebrew library's named-title parallel for Matt 8:20's self-designation is locked in this verse. The figure Enoch saw in heavenly vision is the figure Yahusha (Jesus) names himself as in the gospel.

quote: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

note: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). The spirits that met him among the tombs are named here by origin and by work: the spirits of the giants, afflicting and destroying, hungering and thirsting without food. The two possessed men of Matthew 8:28, *exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way,* were under exactly this.

quote: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
live_here: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
live_proposed: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the Son of Adam's pre-existence-and-naming-before-the-Head-of-Days architecture in the Similitudes — the Son of Adam was named BEFORE creation; his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits. Matt 9:6's *the Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* is the in-flesh exercise of the authority that 1 Enoch 48 names as eternally-pre-existent. The figure who has the Father's-forgiveness-prerogative in flesh is the figure 1 Enoch had named as pre-existent. Red Line #12 governs the named-title rendering (not kaph-comparative).

quote: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.
live_here: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
live_proposed: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
note: *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* 1 Enoch 48:3 intensifies the architecture: the Son of Adam's name was named before creation itself. Matt 9:6's in-flesh exercise of the Father's forgiveness-prerogative is the present-tense demonstration of the eternal-pre-existence the Similitudes had named — the Son of Adam exercising on earth what was his before the foundation of the world.

quote: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’
live_here: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’
live_proposed: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’
note: *And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’* (1 Enoch 71:14). *The Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* (Matthew 9:6). The Parables had already named him the one born unto righteousness, over whom righteousness abides; the forgiveness he speaks on earth is that abiding righteousness exercised in flesh.

quote: And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.
live_here: And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.
live_proposed: And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.
note: *And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.* (1 Enoch 90:25). The shepherds who were set over the sheep and destroyed more than they were bidden end here, judged and cast into the fiery abyss. When Yahusha (Jesus) saw the multitudes *as sheep having no shepherd* (Matthew 9:36), he was looking at the flock those shepherds had left; the vision had already recorded their sentence.

quote: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.

note: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* (1 Enoch 90:29). The shepherdless sheep of Matthew 9:36 are not left shepherdless. Enoch saw the Lord of the sheep bring a new house, greater and loftier than the first, with all the sheep within it. The compassion that moved him at the sight of the scattered flock is the compassion that builds the house.

quote: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.

live_proposed: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.
note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *When he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad* (Matthew 9:36). Enoch saw where the scattering ends: all that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in the house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoicing because they had returned.

quote: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.
live_here: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.
live_proposed: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.
note: *I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.* (1 Enoch 104:1). *Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:32). Enoch swears to the righteous that their names are already written before the glory of the Great One. The Son confesses before the Father the ones whose names were written before they ever confessed.

quote: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.
live_here: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.
live_proposed: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.
note: *And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.* (1 Enoch 103:4). *But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven* (Matthew 10:33). Enoch's word to the righteous who die in righteousness is that their memorial does not perish before the Great One. The warning of Matthew 10:33 is the other side of that promise: a memorial can be kept, and a name can be blotted out (1 Enoch 108:3). The denier is not a tare who never had a name; he is wheat that did not endure.

quote: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children.
live_here: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.
live_proposed: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.
note: *And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children.* 1 Enoch 99:5 names the wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register naming of the day-of-destruction family-disintegration: parents abandoning children, children perishing through parents. Matt 10:35-36's *I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother* walks the same household-division-pattern at the kingdom-citizens-hearing-the-Shepherd-divides-the-household register. The wisdom-stream had named the disintegration-of-the-household as the day-of-destruction signature; the King names the kingdom-hearing-of-his-voice as producing the division-line that runs through the household.

quote: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten, And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.
live_here: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.
live_proposed: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.
note: *And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten, And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.* 1 Enoch 100:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register naming of the family-betrayal-in-the-day-of-destruction architecture: fathers and sons smitten together, brothers falling on brothers. Matt 10:36's *a man's foes shall be they of his own household* (citing Micah 7:6) walks the same architecture. The framework reads the seed-war (Genesis 3:15) as operative at the household-level — the kingdom-citizens' hearing of the Shepherd's voice creates a division-line the family-relationship cannot insulate from. The wisdom-stream had named the diagnostic at the apocalyptic-register; the King names it at the commissioning-discourse register.

note: *But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). The answer sent to Yochanan (John) — *the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them* (Matthew 11:5) — is the peace, protection, mercy, and light Enoch saw promised to the righteous, now arriving in flesh.

quote: And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.
live_here: And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.
live_proposed: And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.
note: *And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* (1 Enoch 10:17). Enoch saw the days when the righteous escape and complete their years in peace, the earth tilled in righteousness and cleansed of oppression (1 Enoch 10:17–22). The works Yahusha (Jesus) lists for Yochanan (John) at Matthew 11:5 are the first fruits of those days — the age Enoch saw, beginning.

quote: And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.

note: *And there I saw One who had a head of days, and His head was white like wool, and with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.* 1 Enoch 46:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Father-Son architecture at the apocalyptic-register: the One-who-had-a-head-of-days (the Father) and the Son-of-Adam-whose-countenance-had-the-appearance-of-a-man-and-whose-face-was-full-of-graciousness (the Son). Matt 11:25-27's Father-Son revelation-economy prayer walks the same architecture at the kingdom-discourse register: the Father (*Lord of heaven and earth*) and the Son (*all things are delivered unto me of my Father; and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son*). The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 11:25-27 names it operative in his own voice.

quote: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.
live_here: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
live_proposed: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-revealing-the-hidden-treasures architecture: the Son-of-Adam reveals the hidden-treasures because Yahuah (God) has chosen him. Matt 11:27's *no man knoweth the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him* walks the same revelation-economy architecture explicitly. The framework reads 1 Enoch 46:3 as the wisdom-stream's named anchor of the *son of Adam* lineage-weight (Red Line #12) restored — the title-naming case where the kaph-comparative is NOT operative; the figure is named the Son of Adam outright. The Matt 11:27 *only the Son reveals the Father* and the 1 Enoch 46:3 *the Son-of-Adam revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden* name the same operative-fact: revelation-of-the-Father is mediated through the Son.

quote: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.
live_here: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.
live_proposed: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.
note: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* 1 Enoch 48:6 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-chosen-and-hidden-before-the-creation-of-the-world architecture. The framework reads the verse as the wisdom-stream anchor of the Red Line #11 *names-written-before-the-foundation-of-the-world* architecture extended to the Son himself — the Son named before the creation, hidden before the Father, revealed-to-the-elect at the appointed-time. Matt 11:27's *no man knoweth the Son, but the Father* names the unique-mutual-knowledge between the chosen-and-hidden-Son and the Father — the relational-substance the wisdom-stream had named at the apocalyptic-register restated by the King at the kingdom-discourse register.

live_proposed: And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.
note: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness.* 1 Enoch 48:7 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the revelation-economy: the wisdom-of-Yahuah (God) reveals the Son-of-Adam to the holy-and-righteous — the body that has hated-and-despised-this-world-of-unrighteousness. The framework reads the verse against Matt 11:25's *thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes* — the revelation-economy at the King's prayer names the same architecture: revelation is to the un-credentialed-receptive (the babes, the holy-and-righteous-who-have-despised-this-world); concealment is from the system-credentialed (the wise-and-prudent, the world-of-unrighteousness). The Father's sovereign-revelation-choice aligns with the substance Red Line #11's seed-war-hearing-pattern names.

quote: Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.
live_here: Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.
live_proposed: Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.
note: *Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.* (1 Enoch 95:7). *Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him* (Matthew 12:14). Enoch's woe already names them: sinners who persecute the righteous, and the heavy yoke that waits for them. The council against the Righteous One is the act the woe was written for.

quote: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore. For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow.
live_here: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
live_proposed: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
note: *For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore. For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow.* 1 Enoch 49:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wisdom-poured-out-on-the-Elect-One architecture. Matt 12:18's *I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the goyim* (citing Isaiah 42:1) walks the same architecture at the gospel-restatement register: the Father's-Spirit-anointing of the Son the King walks publicly through the Galilean-ministry. The framework reads the verse-pair as one architecture across two registers: the wisdom-stream knew the Elect-One's wisdom-anointing-from-the-Father; Matt 12:18 names the operative-fact at the inaugurated-ministry.

quote: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.

note: *And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.* 1 Enoch 49:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the four-spirits-on-the-Elect-One architecture — the same four-spirits-cluster Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 11:2 names of the Branch-from-Yishai (Jesse): the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (the LORD). The framework reads 1 Enoch 49:3 as the wisdom-stream restatement of Isaiah 11:2 applied to the Elect-One — the same Spirit-anointing substance Matt 12:18 names in Yahusha (Jesus) at the immersion (Matt 3:16-17). The Tanakh anchor, the wisdom-stream anchor, and the gospel-fulfillment name one Spirit-anointing-architecture across three registers.

note: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.* (1 Enoch 62:2). *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles* (Matthew 12:18). Enoch saw the same: the spirit of righteousness poured out on the Elect One seated on the throne, and the word of his mouth bringing judgment. The servant of Isaiah and the Elect One of the Parables are one figure, and the Spirit upon him is the same Spirit.

note: *And again Yahuah (the Lord) said to Raphael: Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dudael, and cast him therein. And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever.* 1 Enoch 10:4-5 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the binding-of-the-watchers-leader-Azazel architecture: bound-hand-and-foot, cast-into-the-darkness, sealed-with-rocks, covered-with-darkness for the appointed-time. The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's *how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.* The King's exorcisms-and-spoiling are the inaugurated-form of the binding-architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the watcher-leader register; the full-binding-of-Satan at Revelation 20:1-3 lands the architecture at the millennial-consummation. The wisdom-stream knew the binding-and-darkness-and-appointed-time pattern; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-binding-and-spoiling.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:29's binding-the-strong-man: the wisdom-stream knew the chains-prepared and the abyss-of-condemnation as the eschatological-architecture awaiting Azazel and his hosts; the King at Matt 12:29 walks the inaugurated-action that culminates in the architecture the wisdom-stream had named.

quote: And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.

note: *And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11). *But the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Ghost) shall not be forgiven unto men* (Matthew 12:32). Enoch heard the sentence on those who showed what was hidden and became the damned: no place of repentance for ever. There is a sin that closes the door from the inside; the Pharisees who called the Spirit's work the work of Beelzebub stood at that door.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 12:40's sign-of-Yonah three-days-and-three-nights-in-the-heart-of-the-earth: the wisdom-stream knew the earth-and-Sheol-giving-back-the-dead architecture; the King at Matt 12:40 names the inaugurated-form of the architecture in his own future-resurrection that the Yonah-typology pre-announces. The Yonah-vomited-out-by-the-fish at Yonah (Jonah) 2:10 is the typological-anchor the King draws; the wisdom-stream architecture of Sheol-giving-back is the framework-context.

Enoch says who the *you* are: the holy and righteous to whom the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits reveals him, who have hated this world of unrighteousness. The revealing follows the belonging; it does not create it.

quote: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

note: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). *Then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart* (Matthew 13:19). Enoch names the spirits of the Watchers assuming many forms, leading mankind astray — the actor behind the catching-away. He is not a figure of speech; the restored library records his origin and his end.

And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: "Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children."* 1 Enoch 6:1-2 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the watchers' incursion: the children-of-the-heaven saw-and-lusted-after the daughters-of-men and took-wives-from-among-them. The framework reads the verse as THE foundational-anchor for the tares-sown-by-the-enemy at Matt 13:25. The watchers' incursion produced the corrupted-line-of-the-giants and the spirits-of-the-giants that operate within-the-field-of-the-world as the seed-of-the-wicked-one. The King at Matt 13:25 names the operative-parable-form of the architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the chronological-source register: the enemy-sowing-tares-while-men-slept is the wisdom-stream's watchers-coming-while-men-slept-in-Yared (Jared)'s-days.

quote: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

Enoch names them before the parable does: the children of the Watchers, a seed with a father of its own, distinguished from the line of Adam and marked for destruction. The tares are not bad wheat; they are another seed.

Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.* 1 Enoch 15:8-9 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the spirits-of-the-giants-as-evil-spirits-upon-the-earth architecture: the giants died-physically but the spirits-of-the-giants continue-on-the-earth as evil-spirits. The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:38-39's *the tares are the children of the wicked one ... the enemy that sowed them is the devil.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the spirits-of-the-corruption operating-on-the-earth after the original-watchers' incursion; the King's parable names the operative-form of the seed-distinction at the field-of-the-world register. The evil-spirits-of-the-giants are the operative-instruments of the wicked-one's-sowing across the age.

quote: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.

note: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* (Matthew 13:42). Enoch saw the abyss of fire and the prison appointed for the Watchers — the furnace the parable names, already mapped.

The furnace of Matthew 13:42 has its angels, its day, and its reason — vengeance for leading astray those who dwell on the earth.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 13:43: the wisdom-stream knew the architecture of the righteous-shining-as-the-lights-of-heaven at the day-of-vindication; the King names the operative-form at the wheat-and-tares-interpretation register. Two wisdom-stream witnesses (1 Enoch 104:2 here and Daniel 12:3 at the Tanakh-register) establish the substance the King's parable interpretation names at the gospel-register.

Enoch had named the Son of Adam as the one who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden. The parables are that revealing — hidden things opened, by the one chosen to open them.

The Son-of-Adam-sends-the-angels for both the gathering-of-the-righteous AND the severing-of-the-wicked; the wisdom-stream knew the angelic-architecture; the King names the operative-form.

The seed war is older than the parable. Enoch is shown the spirit of Hevel (Abel), the first righteous blood, making its suit against the seed of Qayin (Cain) until that seed is gone from among the seed of men. Two seeds, from Genesis 4 to the harvest.

The question uses the title Enoch asked about — *that Son of Adam,* the one who went with the Head of Days. The King asks whether men have recognized the figure the Parables named.

The confession at Caesarea Philippi is the angel's answer at 1 Enoch 46:3, spoken on earth.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:16's *thou art the Messiah, the Son of the living Elohim (God).* Kefa's (Peter's)-confession articulates at the earthly-gospel-pivot what 1 Enoch 48:2 names at the heavenly-throne-pivot: the Son-of-Adam's name is the name-named-before-the-Head-of-Days. The wisdom-stream had named the heavenly-substance; the gospel-confession lands the earthly-confession of the same architecture; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates at the Father's-revealing the same substance the wisdom-stream carried.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:17's *flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.* The Father's-revelation to Kefa (Peter) reveals what was always true — the Son-of-Adam's name was named-before-the-sun-and-the-signs-were-created, before-the-stars-of-the-heaven-were-made; the gospel-confession at Caesarea Philippi reveals at the earthly-historical-pivot the substance the wisdom-stream had named at the before-creation register. The framework reads this in continuity with Revelation 13:8 / 17:8's *the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world* and *names written in the book of life from the foundation of the world* — the Father's-foreknowledge architecture the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates within.

The one who holds the secrets delegates their opening.

The keys are given by the one who sits on that throne; the house of David's key (Isaiah 22:22) is on his shoulder before it is in Kefa's (Peter's) hand.

The Father's naming of the Son of Adam at 1 Enoch 71:14 is the same revealing — the Head of Days declaring who he is. Kefa (Peter) receives on earth what Enoch heard in heaven, and the keys follow the revealing.

The sum of judgement was given to the Son of Adam on the throne of his glory; what the apostles bind and loose is bound and loosed under that judgement, not beside it.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 16:18's *the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.* The gates-of-Sheol do not hold-finally because Sheol shall give-back-that-which-it-has-received at the day-of-Yahuah; the assembly built-on-the-King partakes-of-the-resurrection-substance the wisdom-stream had named the architecture for. The framework reads this in continuity with the broader-resurrection-architecture per the first-resurrection of Revelation 20:4-6 and the gathering-of-the-elect from-the-four-winds at Matt 24:31.

The stumbling-blocks laid across the way of the little ones have a history: Azazel taught men the arts that became the snares. The millstone is the King's answer to the teacher of the snare.

quote: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.

note: *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* 1 Enoch 10:8 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the inevitability-of-offences-in-the-present-age substance — the whole earth has-been-corrupted by the watcher-taught substance, and the offences-coming-of-necessity (Matt 18:7's *it must needs be that offences come*) is the architectural-consequence of the corruption-already-running. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:7's *woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh.* The inevitability does-not-excuse the man-by-whom-the-offence-comes; the architecture-of-the-fallen-age makes the offences-inevitable, and the kingdom-citizen-who-becomes-the-substance-that-causes-the-stumble has joined-himself to the watcher-substance the kingdom-came-to-undo. The framework reads this in continuity with Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 24:5-6's *the earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant. Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth.* The earth's-defiling and the curse's-devouring are the architecture 1 Enoch names the source-of and the King-names the consequence-of at the millstone-warning.

quote: Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.

live_proposed: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
note: *Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods.* 1 Enoch 19:1 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the leading-astray (*planao* — the same root the King will use for the *go astray* of the sheep at vv.12-13) substance. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:7's woe-against-the-man-by-whom-the-offence-comes. The fallen-watchers and their spirits operating-in-many-forms across the present-age are the architectural-substance behind every system-of-stumbling-block the King's-millstone-warning lands-on — the institutional-Christianity's antinomian-doctrine, the Hebrew-Roots false-inclusion gospel, the Pharisaic-traditions-of-the-elders, the Galatian-circumcision-party, the Islamic-transfer (the four-costumes per voice skill framework). The lying-spirits-leading-astray are the architecture under the doctrinal-corruptions; the kingdom-citizen-who-joins-the-corruption joins-the-substance the watchers-loosed. The framework reads this with the patience-not-condescension posture per voice skill — the little-ones-led-astray are victims-not-enemies; the systems-and-the-leadership-who-perpetuate-them are where the woe lands.

note: *Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.* (1 Enoch 22:11). *It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea* (Matthew 18:6). Better than what? Than the place Enoch was shown — spirits set apart in great pain until the great day of judgement, and bound there. The sea is the lesser end.

note: *This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (the Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.* 1 Enoch 27:2 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the accursed-valley-of-judgment substance — the Watcher-Book passage (1 Enoch 26-27) describing the valley at the centre of the holy mountain (an explicit topographical-pointer to the *gei-Hinnom* (Valley of the sons of Hinnom) on the southern-edge of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem)). The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:9's *gehenna of fire.* The King's gehenna-substance is the Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream's accursed-valley-of-judgment carried-forward; 1 Enoch 27:2 names the wisdom-stream's identification of the place — *those who are accursed for ever* gathered for the judgment-substance at the place-of-judgment. The framework reads the substance as destruction-substance, not eternal-conscious-maintenance — *here shall be their place of judgement* is the place-where-the-judgment-is-executed, in continuity with 1 Enoch 22:11's consummation-of-the-judgment substance and Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 66:24's carcases-and-worm substance. The disciple cuts-off the hand-foot-eye that causes the stumble because the judgment is real.

note: *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.* (1 Enoch 90:18). *For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost* (Matthew 18:11). The Lord of the sheep comes to the flock in person, staff in hand, and the beasts and birds that devoured them are swallowed by the earth. The saving of the lost is the Lord of the sheep arriving.

live_proposed: And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.
note: *And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.* (1 Enoch 89:54). *If a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?* (Matthew 18:12). Enoch's vision names the owner of the flock: Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, whose house and tower the sheep forsook. The shepherd of the parable is not a hired man; he is the Lord of the sheep seeking his own.

quote: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.

note: *But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.* 1 Enoch 90:6 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the lambs-that-open-their-eyes substance — the post-judgment opening of the eyes-of-the-sheep-who-had-been-blinded under the seventy-shepherds-administration. The framework reads the verse against Matt 18:14's *it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.* The Father's-will is for the lambs-that-open-their-eyes — the substance the King's mustard-seed-faith and the disciples' kingdom-witness gathers; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates in the architecture of the lambs-who-open-the-eyes being-the-substance who-hear-when-the-Shepherd-calls. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the kingdom-witness operationalizes it; the gathering is the Father's-will-substance, not the universalist-overriding-determinism.

quote: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.

note: *And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.* (1 Enoch 90:33). *He rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray* (Matthew 18:13). Enoch saw that joy at the end: the Lord of the sheep rejoicing with great joy because all that had been dispersed had returned to his house. The parable's one sheep is the vision's whole flock.

Enoch is given the names of the four who stand before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits — mercy, healing, power, and repentance unto hope. The little ones are watched over from the throne itself.

live_proposed: Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.
note: *Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.* (1 Enoch 94:8). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). Enoch's woe says why: those who trust in riches depart from them, having not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of their wealth. The difficulty is not the money; it is the trust.

quote: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.
live_here: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.
live_proposed: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.
note: *Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.* (1 Enoch 97:7). *A rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven* (Matthew 19:23). The young ruler's confidence — *all these things have I kept from my youth up* — is the sinner's confidence Enoch names: a remembrance that is evil against him, however secure the holdings look.

quote: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,

live_proposed: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,
note: *And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,* (1 Enoch 97:9). *It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)* (Matthew 19:24). Enoch gives the rich man's own speech — silver gathered, granaries full, *let us do what we purposed.* That speech is the needle's eye closing.

quote: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: Wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; For ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement.
live_here: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.
live_proposed: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.
note: *And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: Wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; For ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement.* 1 Enoch 98:10 names the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the *ye know no ransom* substance — the substance the disciples' *who then can be saved?* at Matt 19:25 presupposes-the-failure-of. The framework reads the verse against the disciples' question. The Enochic-substance names the substance directly: the rich-sinner-substance-presumes-on-the-substance-of-riches-as-ransom; the substance is failed-substance — *ye know no ransom.* The disciples' question at v.25 — *who then can be saved?* — presupposes the inherited-substance that-had-associated-material-prosperity-with-the-Father's-blessing (Bereshit (Genesis) 13:2, 26:12, Devarim (Deuteronomy) 28's covenant-blessings); if-even-the-substance-the-Tanakh-treats-as-blessing is-an-obstacle, who-can-be-saved? The Enochic-substance had named the architecture-of-the-failure-of-the-rich-man's-ransom; the King's-substance at v.26 will-name the substance the Father makes-possible against-the-substance the natural-substance-finds-impossible.

quote: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.
live_here: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.
live_proposed: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.
note: *And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.* (1 Enoch 100:6). *With men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* (Matthew 19:26). Enoch saw the day the children of the earth understand that riches cannot save them. What riches cannot do, Elohim (God) does — that is the whole of the disciples' hope, and the whole of the rich man's.

quote: And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.
live_here: And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.
live_proposed: And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.
note: *And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.* (1 Enoch 62:8). *So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen* (Matthew 20:16). Enoch saw the chosen gathered: the congregation of the elect and holy sown, and all the elect standing before him on that day. The few are not fewer because they tried harder; they are the elect, and the elect are revealed by their standing.

quote: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness which was inexhaustible: and around it were many fountains of wisdom: and all the thirsty drank of them, and were filled with wisdom, and their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.

note: *And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness which was inexhaustible: and around it were many fountains of wisdom: and all the thirsty drank of them, and were filled with wisdom, and their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.* 1 Enoch 48:1 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the all-the-thirsty-drank-and-were-filled substance — the broad-proclamation-substance that reaches-the-many. The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:16's *many be called.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture of the broad-fountain-the-thirsty-drink-from at the prefiguring-register; the gospel-proclamation goes-out broadly because the citizens-of-the-kingdom are scattered-among-the-nations and the proclaimers do-not-know-the-citizens-by-sight. The substance is the broad-substance through-which the citizens-the-Father-has-known emerge — the *thirsty* are the ones whose names-are-written-in-the-Book-of-Life-from-the-foundation-of-the-world and who-hear-the-Shepherd-when-the-Shepherd-calls (John 10:27).

quote: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.
live_here: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

note: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him.* 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the named-Son-of-Adam-who-hath-righteousness substance — the Parables-of-Enoch (chs 37-71) had carried the Son-of-Adam architecture centuries before the gospels articulated it at the gospel-pivot. The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:28's framework-major *even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* The King names himself explicitly as the Son-of-Adam the wisdom-stream had named — the One whom-Yahuah-of-Spirits-hath-chosen, with whom-dwelleth-righteousness. The framework reads this as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam-restoration — the title-substance carries the Adamic-seed-of-promise the canon names through every Son-of-Adam title-position; the *son of Adam* restoration of the inherited-translation's *son of man* preserves the lineage-weight the title carries. The substance the King is about-to-give is the substance-of-the-Adamic-line-of-promise the Father has-carried through-the-prophets to-the-substance-of-the-substantial-ransom-paid-by-the-Son-of-Adam himself.

quote: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.

live_proposed: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
note: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days.* 1 Enoch 48:2 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation substance — *yea, before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (48:3). The framework reads the verse against Matt 20:28's *the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.* The Son-of-Adam-who-came is the same Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation; the substance-of-the-coming was determined by-the-Father from-before-the-foundation-of-the-world; the substantial-ransom is NOT a defeat-imposed-by-circumstances but the substance the Son-walked-into-knowingly under-the-Father's-determination from-before-the-foundation (per the *must* / *dei* of divine-necessity at Matt 16:21's first passion-prediction). The framework reads this in continuity with Hitgalut (Revelation) 13:8's *the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.*
